app.privacyRibbon: Open digital avatar studio · Every cloud data transfer requires explicit user choice
home.title:
Turn meaningful expression
into a companionable digital life.
home.lead: Choose the real-material path or fictional path, and build materials, voice, visual identity, inner world, and long-term memory locally.
home.realCardTitle: Text Persona + Voice Clone + Visual Identity
home.realCardText: For building a multimodal avatar from yourself or an authorized person. Text or chat records are required; audio is used for voice.
home.fictionalCardTitle: Guided Settings + Template Import + Runnable World
home.fictionalCardText: For original characters. Regular users answer step-by-step questions; advanced users import completed templates.
home.hintReal: Real path: text/chat records + voice samples
home.hintFictional: Fictional path: guided creation or template import
home.emptyText: Choose the real-material or fictional path to create your first avatar.
settings.languageHelp: The interface language only changes system text. It does not change the avatar's own language.
identity.customWorldHelp: Custom worlds can use JSON. You can also leave this empty and complete it later in the inner world.

literals.已使用当前模型连接分析，请检查后再保存。: Analyzed using the current model connection. Review before saving.
literals.请通过 start.command、start.sh、start.bat 或桌面: Open using start.command, start.sh, start.bat, or the desktop app. Opening index.html directly only shows a static preview; presets and backend features are unavailable.
literals.请用 start.command、start.sh、start.bat 或桌面应: Open OpenAvatar Studio using start.command, start.sh, start.bat, or the desktop app to use presets, imports, and model connections.
literals.从真实素材创建数字人: Create an avatar from real materials
literals.普通用户默认通过问答生成设定；高级用户可以导入文档。里世界可以很大，也可以只先填: Answer guided questions or import documents. Build an extensive world or begin with just the required modules.
literals.真实路线必须有文字或聊天记录来构建人格，再用音频构建声音；音频不能单独生成人物简: The real-material path requires text or chats for the persona and audio for the voice. Audio alone cannot create a persona summary.
literals.例如：创建一个原创虚构角色，用设定文件定义人格、世界观和说话方式: Example: Create an original character and define their personality, world, and speaking style in a character file
literals.例如：记录自己的表达方式，创建一个可长期陪伴的数字分身: Example: Capture my expressions and create a long-term digital companion
literals.默认用问答一步步生成原创设定；高级用户也可以导入 Markdown、JSON、Y: Create an original character step by step with guided questions, or import Markdown, JSON, or YAML character cards.
literals.不必一次准备齐全。原始文件保存在本机；只有选择云端API并确认后，完成分析所需的: You can add materials gradually. Original files stay on this computer; content needed for analysis is sent to your selected provider only after you choose a cloud API and confirm.
literals.人物包没有摘要，导入后可重新运行 Builder。: This package has no summary. You can rerun Builder after importing.
literals.清单声明可能包含密钥，系统不会导入密钥。: The manifest indicates possible credentials. Credentials will not be imported.
literals.清单声明不包含 API Key。: The manifest declares no API keys.
literals.人物包会迁移数字人语言和世界地区；不会迁移使用者自己的界面语言。: Packages transfer the avatar's language and world region, but not your interface language.
literals.不会导入 API Key，导入后需要重新绑定自己的连接。: API keys are not imported. Reconnect your own services after import.
literals.选择真实素材或虚构设定路线，创建你的第一个数字人。: Choose the real-material or fictional path to create your first avatar.
literals.文件尚未写入人物档案。检查解析结果，并选择合并或覆盖后再确认。: This file has not been applied to the avatar. Review the parsed content and choose merge or replace before confirming.
literals.选择哪些名字代表数字人原型，并取消勾选不希望用于人格与记忆的内容。: Select the names representing the avatar's subject and deselect content you do not want used for persona and memory.
literals.没有识别到明确的说话人，可直接检查内容。: No distinct speakers detected. You can review the content directly.
literals.可以继续导入文档、视觉候选或声音素材，也可以进入下一步选择模型。: Continue importing documents, visual candidates, or voice materials, or proceed to choose a model.
literals.必须项已经完成。接下来可以继续补强声音、视觉、长期记忆和里世界。: Required items are complete. You can improve voice, visuals, long-term memory, and the world next.
literals.完成这个必须项后，数字人才能进入正式使用。: Complete this required item before using the avatar officially.
literals.音频只有确认转写后，才能变成表达样本和长期记忆线索。: Audio becomes an expression sample and memory source only after its transcript is confirmed.
literals.到 VOICE TRANSCRIPTS 面板填写并确认。: Enter and confirm it in VOICE TRANSCRIPTS.
literals.里世界的高影响变化需要你批准，避免运行时自动改 canon。: High-impact world changes require your approval to protect established canon.
literals.到 WORLD PROPOSALS 面板批准或拒绝。: Approve or reject them in WORLD PROPOSALS.
literals.有构建任务正在等待服务商配置。: Some build tasks are waiting for provider configuration.
literals.虚构路线重点看身份、人格、说话方式、边界和里世界模块是否足够。: For fictional characters, check identity, personality, speaking style, boundaries, and world modules.
literals.真实路线重点看文本人格素材、声音样本、声音转写和视觉身份是否足够。: For real-material avatars, check persona text, voice samples, transcripts, and visual identity.
literals.必须项完成后才能正式使用。: Complete required items before official use.
literals.音频转写确认越多，表达样本越稳。: More confirmed transcripts improve expression samples.
literals.必须项已完成，剩余是推荐和高级补强。: Required items are complete; recommended and advanced improvements remain.
literals.高影响事实不应绕过用户审批。: High-impact facts must not bypass user approval.
literals.确认后才能进入证据和记忆。: Confirmation is required before adding to evidence and memory.
literals.还没有证据。确认聊天记录、截图 OCR，或上传声音/图片素材后会显示在这里。: No evidence yet. Confirm chats or screenshot OCR, or upload audio/images to see them here.
literals.回复由你在 AI 设置中选择的模型生成。: Replies are generated by the model you select in AI Settings.
literals.还没有构建任务。导入并确认资料后，任务会显示在这里。: No build tasks yet. Tasks appear here after you import and confirm materials.
literals.虚构数字人的可运行里世界: Runnable world for a fictional avatar
literals.真实素材到多模态数字人: Real materials to a multimodal avatar
literals.必须项完成后可正式使用；可选模块决定里世界深度，事件推进默认进入审批。: Complete required items for official use. Optional modules add world depth; event changes require approval by default.
literals.真实路线必须先有文本人格素材，再用音频、视觉、长期记忆继续增强。: Begin with persona text, then improve with audio, visuals, and long-term memory.
literals.运行统一 Builder 后生成第一批世界事实: Run Unified Builder to generate the first world facts
literals.真实素材路线需要记录授权边界: The real-material path requires recorded authorization boundaries
literals.受保护事实必须由用户批准，运行时不能直接覆盖 canon。: Protected facts require user approval; runtime cannot overwrite canon directly.
literals.张 approved；候选图不会自动进入正式身份。: approved images; candidates never become the official identity automatically.
literals.没有待处理的世界事实提案。运行 Builder 或手动新增事实后会显示。: No pending world fact proposals. Run Builder or add facts to see them here.
literals.填入 ASR 或人工整理后的文本: Enter ASR output or a manually prepared transcript
literals.还没有声音转写记录。上传音频后会进入这里。: No voice transcripts yet. Upload audio to begin.
literals.还没有记忆图谱。确认聊天记录或运行统一 Builder 后会生成。: No memory graph yet. Confirm chats or run Unified Builder to generate one.
literals.最近聊天、构建和模型选择记录: Recent chat, build, and model selection records
literals.人物、服装、物品和场景按组管理；视频只使用已批准素材。: Manage people, clothing, objects, and scenes in groups. Videos use approved assets only.
literals.个场景仍会在视频前触发关键首帧门禁。: scenes still require an approved key frame before video generation.

literals.真实素材路线的声音复制流程: Voice cloning for the real-material path
literals.音频不是人格来源，而是音色与表达样本来源。完成试听确认后才建议正式启用声音。: Audio provides voice characteristics and expression samples, not the persona. Preview and confirm before enabling the voice for official use.
literals.未填写则使用服务默认: Leave blank to use the service default
literals.还没有统一服务连接。推荐先添加 MiniMax 或阿里云直连。: No unified service connections yet. Add a MiniMax or Alibaba Cloud direct connection to start.
literals.主服务失败、未授权或超预算时尝试备用服务: Try the fallback if the primary fails, lacks consent, or exceeds budget
literals.留空使用连接默认: Leave blank to use the connection default
literals.没有自定义 OCR。系统会优先尝试本机已有 OCR；不可用时可以手动补文字。: No custom OCR. The system first tries available local OCR; otherwise, you can enter text manually.
literals.Key 已保存在系统凭据库: Key stored in the system credential store
literals.本地免 Key 或尚未保存 Key: Keyless local connection or no key saved yet
literals.请先在全局 AI 设置中新建一个云端或本地连接。: Create a cloud or local connection in Global AI Settings first.
literals.还没有连接。可以保存一个 OpenRouter、LM Studio、Ollama: No connections yet. Save an OpenRouter, LM Studio, Ollama, or custom local adapter connection.
literals.North/Atlas 已就绪。开始前会再次确认费用和数据传输。: North/Atlas is ready. Cost and data transfer will be confirmed before starting.
literals.尚未配置实时视频通话: Realtime video calling is not configured
literals.LiveKit SDK 加载失败，请检查网络或桌面应用的安全设置: LiveKit SDK failed to load. Check your network or desktop app security settings.
literals.LiveKit 已连接，复刻语音会同步推入头像音轨: LiveKit connected; cloned speech will stream to the avatar audio track
literals.North 没有返回完整的 LiveKit URL/token: North did not return a complete LiveKit URL/token
literals.实时视频通话已创建，North/LiveKit 房间已返回。: Realtime video call created; North/LiveKit room received.
literals.数字人正在理解并回复…: The avatar is processing and replying…

literals.当前浏览器不支持语音识别，请直接输入文字: This browser does not support speech recognition. Please type instead.
literals.语音识别结束，请检查文字后发送。: Speech recognition finished. Review the text before sending.
literals.开源数字人工作室 · 每次云端数据传输都需要用户明确选择: Open avatar studio · Each cloud data transfer requires explicit user choice
literals.选择真实素材路线或虚构设定路线，在本机完成资料、声音、视觉身份、里世界和长期记忆: Choose the real-material or fictional path to build materials, voice, visual identity, a world, and long-term memory locally.
literals.文字人格 + 声音复制 + 视觉身份: Text Persona + Voice Clone + Visual Identity
literals.适合把本人或授权对象做成多模态数字人。必须有文字/聊天记录，音频用于声音。: Create a multimodal avatar of yourself or an authorized person. Text/chat records are required; audio is used for voice.
literals.问答设定 + 模板导入 + 可运行里世界: Guided Creation + Template Import + Runnable World
literals.适合原创角色。普通用户逐步问答，高级用户下载模板后导入完整设定。: Create original characters through guided questions, or download and import a completed template.
literals.虚构路线：问答创建或模板导入: Fictional path: guided creation or template import
literals.人物资料只保存在这台电脑上。真实素材路线和虚构设定路线从入口开始分开构建。: Avatar materials are stored on this computer. Real-material and fictional paths use separate creation flows.
literals.界面语言和数字人语言彼此独立；世界场景会影响 Builder、事件和一致性检查。: Interface and avatar languages are independent. The world region affects Builder, events, and consistency checks.
literals.自定义世界可填写 JSON，也可以先留空，后续在里世界中补充。: Enter custom world rules as JSON, or leave this empty and complete it later.
literals.未成年人角色可以创建，但不会提供性化未成年人的功能。: You can create underage characters, but sexualized content involving minors is not supported.
literals.这是本人资料、完全虚构资料，或资料主体已经明确授权。: These are my materials, entirely fictional materials, or materials explicitly authorized by the subject.
literals.回答几个问题，系统会把答案变成可审批的世界事实。: Answer a few questions to turn your ideas into reviewable world facts.
literals.当前设定问题的答案: Answer to the current character question
literals.写下你的想法。可以很短，也可以很详细。: Write your ideas. Short or detailed answers both work.
literals.模板会明确身份、人格、说话方式、里世界、视觉和声音字段，减少随意文件导致的构建偏: The template defines identity, personality, speaking style, world, visuals, and voice fields to reduce ambiguity during building.
literals.可选，用于试听或接入语音服务: Optional, for previews or voice services
literals.截图会优先使用本机 OCR 或用户配置的 OCR；音频会进入声音复制流程，先保存: Screenshots use local or configured OCR first. Audio enters the voice workflow: save samples, check quality, confirm transcripts, select a cloning service, and approve a preview.
literals.每一项都可以修改。资料不足的地方保持空白，不会自动编造。: You can edit every item. Missing information stays blank and is not invented automatically.
literals.先在“全局 AI 设置”里保存模型连接。API Key 只交给本机后端保存到系统: Save a model connection in Global AI Settings first. The local backend stores API keys in the system credential store, never in the page, database, or avatar packages.
literals.API Key使用系统凭据库保存。主动联系、重新分析和聊天都会调用当前模型，云端: API keys are saved in the system credential store. Proactive contact, reanalysis, and chat use the current model; cloud mode may incur charges.
literals.你可以马上聊天，也可以继续补充资料。主动联系默认关闭；开启后会调用当前模型，云端: Start chatting or add more materials. Proactive contact is off by default; enabling it uses the current model and may incur cloud API charges.
literals.数据由当前模型设置处理: Data is processed using the current model settings
literals.开始通话后会显示 North 返回的实时头像画面。: The realtime avatar video returned by North will appear after the call starts.
literals.可以点击麦克风说话，也可以直接输入文字。: Use the microphone or type your message.
literals.通话已连接。浏览器语音识别可能使用操作系统或浏览器提供的服务；也可以只输入文字。: Call connected. Browser speech recognition may use operating-system or browser services; you can also type.
literals.预览聊天与正式人生档案完全隔离，除非以后明确转为正式经历。: Preview chats are separate from the official life archive unless explicitly converted into official experiences later.
literals.真实素材和虚构设定都会先进入这里: Real materials and fictional settings are reviewed here first
literals.从资料到可运行数字人: From materials to a runnable avatar
literals.这里展示必须项、推荐项、高级项、世界骨架、视觉审批、声音选择和构建任务。: Review required, recommended, and advanced items, world structure, visual approvals, voice selection, and build tasks.
literals.默认继承全局默认连接；也可以为这个数字人指定一个云端或本地连接。: Inherits the global default connection unless you assign a cloud or local connection to this avatar.
literals.默认关闭。开启后，程序运行期间会按设定间隔调用当前模型；云端模式可能产生API费: Off by default. When enabled, the running app calls the current model at the configured interval. Cloud models may incur charges; local models use computer resources.
literals.近况, 关心, 延续上次话题: Recent events, checking in, continuing the last topic
literals.自然、简短、有边界感: Natural, brief, and respectful of boundaries
literals.允许使用长期记忆选择话题: Allow long-term memory for topic selection
literals.只使用当前数字人的记忆与设定。: Only uses this avatar's memories and settings.
literals.高影响事件仍进入世界事实审批。: High-impact events still require world fact approval.
literals.我建议使用“步骤卡 + 关键提示”：第一次用步骤卡讲清楚全局流程，进入系统后再用: Follow these steps for an overview. Hints within each page will help you along the way.
literals.真实素材路线用于本人或授权人物；虚构设定路线用于原创角色和可运行里世界。: Use real materials for yourself or an authorized person, or the fictional path for original characters and runnable worlds.
literals.真实路线必须有文本内容，声音用于音色；虚构路线默认问答式，高级用户先下载模板再导: Real avatars require text for the persona and audio for voice. Fictional avatars use guided questions or imported templates.
literals.用户可以使用任意兼容 API 或本地模型。Key 只保存到系统凭据库，不进入人物: Use a compatible API or local model. Keys stay in the system credential store and are excluded from avatar packages.
literals.构建中心会告诉你下一步该补什么，并处理视觉审批、声音转写、世界事实和质量评测。: Find the next step and manage visual approvals, transcripts, world facts, and quality checks.
literals.上传文件默认在本机保存。只有用户选择云端服务并确认后，必要资料片段才会发送给对应: Uploads are saved locally by default. Relevant excerpts are sent to a cloud provider only after you choose that service and confirm.
literals.这里把常见问题翻译成可操作提示：模型连接、数据库、目录权限、OCR 和本地服务都: Check model connections, database health, directory permissions, OCR, and local services, with actionable guidance.
literals.数据库、原始素材、导出包和构建记录默认保存在本机 data 目录。: The database, original materials, exports, and build records are stored in the local data directory by default.
literals.只有用户配置云端 API 并确认后，分析和聊天所需片段才会发送给用户选择的服务商: Excerpts needed for analysis and chat are sent to your chosen provider only after you configure a cloud API and confirm.
literals.优先使用本机已有 OCR；用户也可接入自己的本地命令、本地 HTTP 服务或云端: Available local OCR is preferred. You can connect your own local command, local HTTP service, or cloud OCR API.
literals.确认后的聊天、OCR 文本和转写文本会进入本地记忆与证据库，可删除数字人时一并删: Confirmed chats, OCR text, and transcripts enter the local memory and evidence library and are removed when you delete the avatar.
literals.声音复刻、TTS、参考图生成需要单独确认，可能产生费用。: Voice cloning, TTS, and reference image generation require separate confirmation and may incur charges.
literals.人物包不包含 API Key，但可能包含聊天、声音、图片和世界设定，因此仍是敏感: Packages exclude API keys but may include chats, voices, images, and world settings. Treat them as sensitive files.
literals.人物包可能包含敏感资料。系统会先检查格式、版本、内容清单和密钥声明，确认后才导入: Packages may contain sensitive materials. The system checks format, version, contents, and credential declarations before you confirm import.
literals.人格、世界和审批结果始终包含；API Key 永远不会导出。原始资料可能非常敏感: Persona, world, and approval results are always included. API keys are never exported. Original materials may be sensitive; include only what the recipient needs.
literals.包含确认过的聊天素材和应用内聊天历史。: Includes confirmed chat materials and in-app chat history.
literals.不包含 API Key；外部复刻声音需要重新绑定。: Excludes API keys. External cloned voices must be reconnected.
literals.包含人物包中的本地图片文件。: Includes local image files in the avatar package.
literals.可单独排除视频文件和视频验收记录。: Video files and acceptance records can be excluded separately.
literals.包含通话摘要和逐轮文字，不包含 API Key。: Includes call summaries and turn-by-turn text, but no API keys.
literals.例如：黑色短发，蓝色外套，右手佩戴手表；可用逗号分隔: Example: short black hair, blue jacket, watch on right wrist; separate with commas
literals.保存后，后续生图和视频会自动使用这组规则及参考图。: Future image and video generation will use these rules and reference images after saving.
literals.OpenAvatar 不是固定离线或固定云端。每个能力可以单独选择本地、云端、手: Each capability can use a local service, a cloud service, manual input, or remain disabled.
literals.普通用户不需要编辑 .env。API Key 只在这里输入一次，保存到系统凭据库: You do not need to edit .env. Enter API keys here once; they are stored in the system credential store, never displayed again, and excluded from avatar packages.
literals.界面语言只影响系统文字，不会改变数字人的主要语言。: Interface language changes system text only, not the avatar's primary language.
literals.MiniMax、阿里、OpenRouter、本地服务都在这里保存；一个连接可以提: Save MiniMax, Alibaba Cloud, OpenRouter, and local services here. One connection can provide several capabilities.
literals.只保存到系统安全凭据库: Stored only in the system credential store
literals.高级配置（JSON，可覆盖 MiniMax 端点）: Advanced Configuration (JSON; can override MiniMax endpoints)
literals.为每项能力选择主连接、备用连接和模型；运行时真正按这里执行。: Choose a primary connection, fallback, and model for each capability. Runtime follows these settings.
literals.分析、聊天、主动联系和构建都使用这里的连接。: Analysis, chat, proactive contact, and building use these connections.
literals.保存后清空，可留空用于本地服务: Cleared after saving; optional for local services
literals.允许云端连接接收必要文字: Allow cloud connection to receive necessary text
literals.本地连接不需要勾选；云端连接必须勾选后才能保存。: Not required for local connections. Cloud connections require this consent before saving.
literals.优先用本机已有 OCR；高级用户可以接入自己的 OCR。: Uses available local OCR first. Advanced users can connect their own OCR.
literals.本地命令只适合高级用户。请只填写你信任的本机 OCR 程序，不要粘贴陌生人给你的: Local commands are for advanced users. Use only trusted OCR programs on your computer; never paste commands from strangers. You can use detected OCR, enter text manually, or connect a trusted local/cloud OCR service.

literals.这个 OCR 需要 API Key: This OCR requires an API key
literals.允许云端 OCR 接收截图图片: Allow cloud OCR to receive screenshots
literals.本地命令和本地 HTTP 不需要勾选；云端 OCR 必须让用户知道图片会发送出去: Local command and HTTP OCR do not require this consent. Cloud OCR sends images to the provider.
literals.声音/参考图使用阿里云百炼；实时视频通话固定使用 North/Atlas，不提供: Voice and reference images use Alibaba Cloud Bailian. Realtime video calls use North/Atlas with no custom provider option.
literals.North/Atlas 负责实时口型 Avatar 和 LiveKit 房间。O: North/Atlas provides lip-synced avatars and LiveKit rooms. OpenAvatar manages persona, memory, TTS, backgrounds, view flips, visual feedback, and North session release at call end.
literals.阿里云百炼 API Key（声音/参考图，可留空）: Alibaba Cloud Bailian API key (voice/images; optional)
literals.留空时使用当前数字人的 canonical/approved 图: Leave blank to use this avatar's canonical/approved image
literals.provider 固定为 North/Atlas。: The provider is fixed to North/Atlas.
literals.允许在我每次确认后上传授权的声音、照片或实时视频通话数据: Allow authorized audio, images, or realtime call data to be uploaded after each confirmation
literals.North 会接收身份参考图/Face URL、LiveKit 实时轨道和通话状: North receives the identity reference/Face URL, LiveKit tracks, and call state. Charges may depend on call duration.
